A '''Magnetometer''' was a component of a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]].<ref name="TG" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Jula Darklighter]] had [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] install a magnetometer in his market skiff in preparation for the rescue search for Chewbacca's partner [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="TG" />
